Full Dip violet spray wrap colours are very simple to apply. It is recommended to use a grey primer with all colours except Black and grey. Full Dip violet spray wrap comes in a ready to use Aerosol or 4 Litre premixed tins. Sprap wraps will protect your existing body colour and will change colour with a matt finish. It can be easily removed by peeling off the wrap.
You spray wrap will be peeling for more than 10 years. Properties                           Liquid Vinyl application means once dried it becomes a tough elastic and durable film. Easily removed.
